description: §14.8.10 (S455) — a `<schema>` VIEW over `notes`, which is tenant-scoped through `ALTER TABLE notes ADD COLUMN tenant_id`. Before S455 the ALTER-added column was not read, `notes` was not in the tenant set, and the view passed the E-TENANT-SCHEMA-HAZARD checker (compiled clean, executed on e014f20ce). Now the view is refused at the declaration.
rationale: §14.8.10: a `<schema>` declaring a view whose definition reads a tenant-scoped table SHALL be E-TENANT-SCHEMA-HAZARD; a table is tenant-scoped when its `<schema>` carries a `tenant_id` column — S455: an `ALTER TABLE` that names `tenant_id` included.
